title: Best Display Advertising Experts (2026): Banner and Retargeting Ads
description: How to hire a display ads expert for banner, retargeting or programmatic campaigns: targeting, creatives, tracking, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Display advertising experts run image and video ads across websites and apps, through ad networks and programmatic platforms. Display ads are useful for awareness and for retargeting people who visited your site. Campaigns go wrong when targeting is too broad, ads appear on low-quality sites, tracking is missing, or frequency is so high that people get annoyed. This guide helps you hire someone who spends your budget carefully.

faq.q: What are display ads good for?
faq.a: Brand awareness, reaching new audiences and reminding past visitors through retargeting. Direct sales from cold display ads are often lower than from search ads.
